qa.question: I have an Orchis, Vengeful Puppet and Puppet token on my field. If I attack an enemy Rookie Succubus with my Puppet token, causing both to be destroyed, can I select the enemy Forest Bat token summoned by Rookie Succubus's Last Words ability and deal it 2 damage?

qa.question: Does "If this follower would take more than 3 damage, it takes 3 instead" mean that the selected follower can only take 3 damage a turn?

qa.title: Q1055 (Jan. 31, 2025)
qa.question: If an opponent has 7 cards in their cemetery, and I summon an Octrice, Omen of Usurpation and Zealot of Usurpation from my cemetery with this follower's On Evolve ability, can I put the top card of my deck into my EX area with Zealot of Usurpation's Fanfare ability?
qa.answer:
Yes. Since both Octrice, Omen of Usurpation's Fanfare ability and Zealot of Usurpation's Fanfare ability trigger and become pending at the same time, you may resolve them in any order.

To put the top card of your deck into your EX area, you must resolve Octrice, Omen of Usurpation's Fanfare ability first to bring the number of cards in your cemetery to 9. You then resolve Zealot of Usurpation's Fanfare ability to bring the number of cards in your cemetery to 10, satisfying the "if there are at least 10 cards in opponents' cemeteries" condition.

qa.title: Q1090 (Jan. 31, 2025)
qa.question: An opponent only has a Mordecai the Duelist on their field, and I summon and destroy an Underworld Watchman Khawy and Yuzuki, Righteous Demon with this follower's Fanfare ability. If I choose to destroy that enemy Mordecai the Duelist with Underworld Watchman Khawy's Last Words ability first, does my Yuzuki, Righteous Demon's Fanfare ability cause that opponent to bury the Mordecai the Duelist summoned by its own Last Words?
qa.answer:
No. The active player always resolves their abilities before non-active players.

In this case, after resolving Underworld Watchman Khawy's Last Words ability, the opponent's Mordecai the Duelist is destroyed and its Last Words ability triggers and becomes pending. Then, as the active player, you must resolve Yuzuki, Righteous Demon's Fanfare ability first. At this point the Mordecai the Duelist is in the opponent's cemetery, so nothing happens because your opponent doesn't have any followers on the field they can bury. Afterwards, the opponent resolves their Mordecai the Duelist's Last Words ability.
